thread:
ravi: Throwing this out there - we should build a 'replica preview' flow that can run a low-impact shadow of a config change and return a concise safety verdict before rollout.
elaine: love it. must include cost modelling fallback when we can't mirror traffic (PII or consent issues).
sam: important constraints: do not double user-visible traffic, enforce backend caps, and surface sample size/confidence.
claire: UX: "Start preview" modal -> choose mode [mirror | modeled], sample pct, time window, exclude regions/tenants. show quick summary card with p50/p95 delta, error delta, estimated cost delta, and a green/yellow/red verdict.
ravi: API sketch:
POST /internal/config/preview-run
{ "config_id": "route_policy_v5", "mode": "modeled", "sample_pct": 1, "window_min": 30 }
ops-bot: runbook: "If any backend reports saturation >0.55 -> auto-pause preview, mark verdict INCONCLUSIVE, notify #eng-oncall."
elaine: telemetry contract: emit 'preview_report' containing config_id, mode, sample_pct, p50_delta_ms, p95_delta_ms, error_delta_ppm, cost_estimate_usd, confidence_low, confidence_high, sample_count. ship to 'config-sim' topic.
sam: safe rollout predicate idea: allow_rollout_if(preview.p95_delta_ms < 15 && preview.error_delta_ppm < 250 && preview.cost_delta_pct < 7). make it pluggable in rollout API.
claire: privacy: mask user IDs, remove raw prompt text, honor tenant consent; if consent absent switch to modeled mode automatically.
ravi: ownership: i'll do the console bits + audit logging. @sam take replay runner + rate limiting?
sam: taking runner. will add per-backend probes and saturation guarding.
elaine: i'll wire telemetry and the dashboard tile showing recent previews and verdict history. include links to raw reports.
ops-bot: reminder: log preview initiator, config_id, mode to audit trail.
claire: i'll loop in compliance for consent wording.
ravi: OK let's sketch minimal API and ship an MVP behind a runtime flag. moving this to #design for mocks.
